title: Plain IRC listener on any address (decision mimid-1wgh.92)
description: Implements decision mimid-1wgh.92. Remove the loopback restriction from the plain IRC listener, keep authentication mandatory, keep the 127.0.0.1:6667 default, and restate every document that says the agent serves plaintext only on loopback.
close_reason: Landed d92539b1 and pushed: the plain IRC listener takes any address, the config and bind checks and the accept-loop peer drop all removed, both now-unreachable error variants gone, authentication unchanged and still mandatory, docs restated across AGENTS.md, frontend-auth.md and client-survey.md S1.
